_comment: Copy to mines.json and edit. Each entry below is one guarded directory = one mine. mines.json is never committed.

_field_guide.settings.upload_monitor: global: supervise netwatch.py record (outbound targets + upload volume)
_field_guide.settings.action: default trigger action for new mines: warn | explode
_field_guide.settings.daemon_enabled: last known state of the master switch (restored on console start)
_field_guide.mines[].action: trigger action for this mine: warn (record only) | explode (kill the moving process)
_field_guide.mines[].id: optional; derived deterministically from the path when omitted

mines.note: The watcher's own directory — the evidence.
